messages:
Priya (Marketing): Need a razor-fast battlecard update for next week's launch. Focus: one metric headline vs managed cloud endpoints, three SDR hooks, and routing rules for high-intent leads.

Ravi (Product Marketing): Metric idea: 'Reduce effective per-token cost by ~30% at production QPS.' Storyline: predictable unit economics + deployment flexibility.

Mateo (Eng-ML): Bench snapshot (chat seq128): redwood-v1 quant shows ~28% lower cost_per_1k after batching and ~30ms tighter p95 vs CloudAPI-prod. I'll drop CSV.

Sam (Sales): SDR hooks (short): 1) "Cut token costs with intelligent batching." 2) "Consistent p95s for production apps." 3) "Private deployments + KMS for compliance."

Ava (Field): Procurement bullets (two): 1) KMS + VPC + audit logs for governance. 2) Rollouts + regional fallback reduce ops risk during incidents.

Lila (Growth): Routing rule: lead form with 'SLA priority' -> Dedicated queue; security checkbox -> Field AE. I'll add hidden utm for tracking.

Priya (Marketing): Great—Ravi compile into a one-page battlecard and share by EOD Wednesday. Mateo attach bench link, Sam finalize SDR playbook, Lila wire routing. Ping me if blocked. :rocket:
